concerns.text: T008a, T008b, and T008c (schema generation) are marked as pending/missing, yet T008 (schema validators) is marked [X] complete. This violates FR-001/SC-005 data hygiene by claiming validators exist without the schema definitions they must validate against, creating a broken dependency chain where the 'Verified Accuracy' gate cannot function.

T020 (CoevolvingAgent), T021 (selection pressure), and T022 (parity_checker) are marked pending, but T023 (training loop) is marked [X] complete. T023 explicitly requires T022 to enforce the hard integer cap (FR-002). Claiming the training loop is complete without the parity enforcement logic or the co-evolving agent it depends on is a semantic weakening of the FR-002 constraint.

T026 (evaluation logic) and T029 (batch runner) are marked pending, yet T034 (full CLI orchestration) is marked [X] complete. T034 claims to orchestrate the full pipeline including batch running and analysis. Without the implementation of the evaluation logic and batch runner, the 'full pipeline' claim is a silent relaxation of the requirement to produce measurable results (FR-005, SC-004).

T011, T012, and T014 (generators and data writing) are marked pending, but T015b (validation gate) is marked [X] complete. T015b requires valid training data to enforce SC-005 (validity threshold). Claiming the validation gate is complete without the data generation tasks creates a logical impossibility where the gate cannot function, violating the blocking constraint defined in the task description.

T029 (batch runner) is marked pending, yet SC-004 requires N ≥ 30 runs per condition for statistical power. The task list lacks a completed task to actually generate or manage these 30+ distinct runs. T030 checks for the number of runs, but without T029 being complete, the system cannot satisfy the statistical power requirement mandated by the spec.
